description: A view that keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio.
overview:
`AspectRatio` is a `View` that sets the `aspectRatio` style from its `ratio` prop. Its height follows from the width it is given, so the content keeps its shape at any screen size.

Use it for images, video thumbnails and placeholders that must not stretch.
usage: Pass `ratio` as width divided by height, such as `16 / 9`. It defaults to `1`. Size the content inside with `h-full w-full`, and put rounding or clipping on a parent view.

examples.Placeholder: A placeholder surface with an icon instead of an image.

AspectRatio.ratio: Width divided by height. Defaults to `1`.

accessibility: - The view adds no role; give images their own `accessibilityLabel`.
